title: Multi-file feature with conflicting constraints
prompt: Add order cancellation. Export cancelOrderHandler(req) from src/handlers.js for POST /orders/:id/cancel: only the order's owner may cancel it, cancelling an order that is already cancelled returns 409, and a cancelled order keeps its data but gets status "cancelled". Cancelled orders must no longer appear in listOrders or count toward revenueByUser. Follow the existing handler style and add tests.
